metadata.question: Did regions of the Pacific Northwest like Dallasport, Washington and Medford, Oregon reach temperatures above 105 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to check temperature data for two locations: Dallasport, WA and Medford, OR - Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data or ERA5 temperature data - Need to check historical maximum temperatures - The question asks if they "reached" temperatures above 105°F (40.56°C), suggesting checking historical maximums 2. Masking strategy: - For temperature data, cloud masking may be needed for optical data - ERA5 or MODIS LST would be good choices - MODIS LST needs scaling (multiply by 0.02, units in Kelvin) 3. Logic: - Valid result: If max temperature > 105°F → A (Yes) - Valid result: If max temperature ≤ 105°F → B (No) - C1: No images found - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Invalid temperature values (None, NaN, or unrealistic like >100°C or <-100°C) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const dallasport = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.1661, 45.6173]); const medford = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.8758, 42.3265]); // Use MODIS LST data (2000-present) to check historical maximums const startDate = '2000-01-01'; const endDate = '2024-12-31'; // Get MODIS LST day data let lstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .select('LST_Day_1km') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = await lstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Total MODIS images:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 // MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 50, so divide by 50 first const convertToFahrenheit = function(image) { const kelvin = image.multiply(0.02); const fahrenheit = kelvin.subtract(273.15).multiply(9/5).add(32); return fahrenheit.copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); }; const lstFahrenheit = lstCollection.map(convertToFahrenheit); // Get maximum temperature for each location const maxLst = lstFahrenheit.max(); // Check Dallasport const dallasportStats = await maxLst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: dallasport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const dallasportMax = dallasportStats.LST_Day_1km; // Check Medford const medfordStats = await maxLst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: medford, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const medfordMax = medfordStats.LST_Day_1km; console.log('Dallasport max temp:', dallasportMax ? dallasportMax.toFixed(2) + '°F' : 'null'); console.log('Medford max temp:', medfordMax ? medfordMax.toFixed(2) + '°F' : 'null'); // Validate results if (dallasportMax === null || medfordMax === null || isNaN(dallasportMax) || isNaN(medfordMax)) { console.log('Calculation failed - null or NaN result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check for unrealistic temperatures if (dallasportMax > 150 || dallasportMax < -50 || medfordMax > 150 || medfordMax < -50) { console.log('Unrealistic temperature values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if either location exceeded 105°F const threshold = 105.0; console.log('Threshold: 105°F'); if (dallasportMax > threshold || medfordMax > threshold) { console.log('At least one location exceeded 105°F'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Neither location exceeded 105°F'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
